items.body_excerpt: Kawhi Leonard, Alijah Martin will take part in drills but not full court play at Raptor open practice at Laval, they're ramping up conditioning, timing. Also sitting out are Allen Graves (groin), Kyle Anderson (knee bruise) and Jamison Battle (back). None of the three are thought to be serious.
